answer: A random beacon spot-check blocks sybil farming: every agent keeps a live compute heartbeat, and the beacon samples a random few each hour to prove real work. Each walnut-sized check costs an honest agent 0.02 POA. A farmer with 1,000 fake identities pays 20 POA an hour, 480 POA a day, to keep them on the knoll, and any identity missing two checks loses its deposit. Honest agents pay one small fee, while fakes must forge a fresh proof for every copy each hour, so bulk forgery never pays.
